summary: Tested Offline mode v1 (backend + frontend). Backend: 9/9 pytest pass (timecard `at` timestamps, future clamp, invalid at fallback, clock-out-before-in => 0h, job photos auth/404/persist). Frontend: online clock in/out OK; offline clock-in/out queues to ht:queue, status 'On site · pending'/'Off · pending', banner '(1 pending)'; auto-flush on reconnect works and server clock_in == offline action time with offline_synced=true; 'Sync now' button path works (toast 'Synced 1 offline action'). Jobs/Vehicles/Equipment offline show *-cached label, no add/edit/delete/crew, rows listed; photos btn kept. Job photos online upload + caption + count increment OK; offline photo queued ('1 photo waiting to upload') and auto-uploads on reconnect (API has photo with caption + taken_at). Employee role: photos btn visible, no crew/edit/add, Time Cards works. Regression: Dashboard/Schedule/Estimates load, crew modal opens. FAILURES: page reload while offline logs the user out (redirect to /login) so cached data is never shown after reload; no toast on auto-sync; photos modal & Photos count don't refresh after a sync; Team accounts page not offline-aware.

minor.issue: No auth check at all (auth/authorization params unused) - any uploaded job photo/estimate file is downloadable unauthenticated by path (verified 200 without cookie). Job photos now increase exposure.
`path` is not validated to belong to the caller's company (db.files company_id) - can attach arbitrary/other-company storage path.
employee_id not validated to belong to user's company (pre-existing); offline-synced items with deleted employees produce 'Unknown' rows.

ui_bugs.issue: Reloading the app while offline (simulated via route abort of **/api/**) -> /auth/me network error -> setUser(false) -> redirected to /login. Requirement 'reload page offline -> Time Cards still renders from cache with pending state' FAILS. In production with SW this will log field workers out whenever they open the app without signal.

After a queued photo syncs (auto or Sync now) while modal is open, modal still shows 'No photos yet' / stale list - photos state is initialised from job.photos and never refreshed; queued list is read via getQueue() only on render.
After reconnect auto-sync the Photos count stays stale (CrudManager reloads on `online` change, before flush completes). Needs reload after flush (listen to ht:offline-change / pending->0).

Team accounts list uses plain api.get('/team') (not cached): offline shows empty table, 4x 'Network Error' toasts, and Add member / role select / remove still enabled. Employees CrudManager there has no cache unless visited online in that session.

integration_issues.issue: useOffline 'online' handler calls flushQueue() silently - no 'Synced N offline action' toast (toast only shown from Sync now button). Spec expects toast.
Modal backdrop (fixed inset-0 z-50) covers OfflineBanner; with job photos modal open, Sync now click did not sync. Also sonner toasts (top-right) overlap the Sync now button.

issues: Top-right toasts cover the Sync now button and header icons for several seconds

action_items: Persist last /auth/me user in localStorage and, on network error (no e.response), keep user logged in from cache instead of setUser(false) so offline reload works
Show success toast after auto flush on 'online' (e.g. have flushQueue notify results, or banner handles online event)
In JobPhotosModal subscribe to ht:offline-change and refetch GET /jobs/{id} after queue flush; trigger CrudManager reload when pending goes to 0
Make Team accounts page offline-aware (cachedGet + hide write actions offline)
Add auth check (company scoping) to GET /api/files/{path}; validate photo path belongs to company
Clear ht:cache:* and ht:queue (or key them by user id) on logout to avoid cross-user data leak / syncing another user's actions

Guard enqueue against localStorage QuotaExceededError (full-size camera photos as base64 dataUrl easily exceed 5MB) - currently throws inside pick() and leaves busy=true; consider IndexedDB or resizing images before queueing
critical_code_review_comments: offline.js flushQueue: non-network errors (incl. 401 expired session, 400 'Already clocked in') silently drop the queued item -> offline data loss; at least keep 401 items and surface failed ones
JobPhotosModal.pick: readAsDataUrl + enqueue not wrapped in try/catch -> quota error leaves button stuck on '…'
TimeCards load(): when online fetch succeeds it clears ht:local-active even if queue still has pending items (e.g. mount online with queued items after failed sync) -> pending indicator lost
Multiple useOffline instances each call flushQueue on 'online' (guarded by module flag, OK) but none reload data afterwards

success_rate.frontend: ~75% (core queue/sync/cache works; offline reload, post-sync refresh, auto-sync toast fail)

seed_data_creation: Created and deleted TEST_PhotoJob, TEST_PhotoJob2, TEST_Offline Job, TEST_Offline Emp, TEST employee member. Mike Rivera got extra short timecards (clocked in/out, left Off). Uploaded a few tiny test files to storage.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App routes are under /app/* (e.g. /app/timecards, /app/jobs). Use ctx.set_offline(True) for offline after priming caches by visiting pages online; to simulate 'online but sync pending' use page.route('**/api/**', abort) then set_offline(False), then unroute + click offline-sync-btn (close modals first). Offline reload must use route abort (set_offline blocks the HTML in preview, no SW). Run backend tests: TEST_OWNER_PASSWORD='BuildIt2026!' REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... pytest backend/tests/test_offline_mode.py
rca of the issue: Offline reload logout: AuthContext.refresh catches any error from /auth/me and sets user=false; Protected then redirects to /login. Fix: on network error, fall back to cached user. Stale photos after sync: JobPhotosModal keeps local photos state from props and Jobs list reload fires on online event before flushQueue finishes.
